summary: Base corrected $25 -> $32 (high $43 -> $57): all 86 no-hookup sites are listed at 20 ft, so a 23-ft rig's cheapest site is full hookup. Added 50 amp full hookups, lengths, facilities. North and South measured; pin ~520 m off, on the marina.
flags: BASE: RA lists all 86 Standard (no hookup) sites as '20 Back-In', below EKKO's length, so I moved the base to full hookup. Confirmed today at $57 on 7/13/2027 against $43 Standard. The 20 ft may just be a nominal figure on open paved rows; if you'd rather count them, restore $25-43 with the $14 full_hookup surcharge.

NORTH / SOUTH (not split, your call): two camping areas either side of Indian River Inlet. Imagery centres: North ~38.6101,-75.0668, South ~38.6051,-75.0670, so ~550 m straight-line across the inlet, longer by road since the visible link is the Route 1 bridge. Each appears to have its own entrance off Route 1, north and south of the bridge (imagery estimate; Overpass was down, so no road data). That's under the ~1 km split line straight-line. RA has one facility and no North/South labels, so I could not assign site counts or prices to either. RV Life treats them as two parks (North 88 sites, pin 38.61087,-75.06502; South 38.60574,-75.06503). destateparks.com, where the dossier's 88/151/86/33 would be checked, was unread. RA's 224 full-hookup total vs the dossier's 88+151=239: not reconciled.

PIN OFF ~520 m: stored 38.612828,-75.071629 is on the Indian River Marina boat-trailer rows, not a campground. North area rows are at about 38.6101,-75.0668; if one point stands for both, that's the better one.

WATERFRONT riverview stands on AWH's firsthand note ('Some sites have partial views of the river'); asking rather than changing. Imagery: on both sides a road and seawall path run between the outer rows and the inlet, so views are likely and on-water isn't. RA marks every site 'Near Water - no'. Whether Indian River Inlet reads as bay or river I left alone. I did not read site photos here.

UNREAD: destateparks.com answered 403 to plain UA; not retried, so its alerts and the North/South page are unread. RA: 'Open year round'; 'Water at campsites is turned off on or around November 15th; frost free spigots are available to fill camper tanks.' RA carries phone 302-227-2800 or 302-227-6981. RV Life South 4.5 stars, $$$ avg $47; North avg $55.
